title: G$^2$WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2610.16558v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models capture environment dynamics and support counterfactual reasoning for planning. In image-goal navigation, where the target often lies beyond the current field of view, the agent must not only model environmental dynamics but also maintain a persistent spatial memory of the scene. Existing approaches either introduce spatial context by fine-tuning pretrained models on the target task, which underexploits their spatial priors, or rely on external 3D reconstruction, which is computationally expensive for real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose the Geometry Grounded World Action Model (G$^2$WAM) for image-goal navigation. G$^2$WAM encodes spatial cues through a learned scene-coordinate localization module that anchors the current, goal, and history frames in a common reference frame, yielding a stable and consistent spatial context that enables efficient navigation without explicit 3D reconstruction. translated_title: G$^2$WAM：面向高效且几何锚定的图像目标导航的世界动作模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型能够捕捉环境动态，并支持用于规划的反事实推理。在图像目标导航任务中，由于目标通常位于当前视野之外，智能体不仅需要对环境动态进行建模，还需要保持对场景的持久空间记忆。现有方法要么通过在目标任务上微调预训练模型来引入空间上下文，但这未能充分利用模型的空间先验；要么依赖外部3D重建，而这对于真实场景部署而言计算成本过高。在本文中，我们提出了面向图像目标导航的几何锚定世界动作模型（G$^2$WAM）。G$^2$WAM通过一个学习得到的场景坐标定位模块来编码空间线索，该模块将当前帧、目标帧和历史帧锚定到一个共同的参考坐标系中，从而生成稳定且一致的空间上下文，使导航无需显式3D重建即可高效进行。遵循世界……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出几何锚定世界动作模型G$^2$WAM，通过学习场景坐标定位模块将当前帧、目标帧和历史帧锚定到统一参考坐标系，从而在无需显式3D重建的情况下，为图像目标导航提供稳定一致的空间上下文并实现高效导航。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes G$^2$WAM, a Geometry Grounded World Action Model that anchors current, goal, and history frames in a common reference frame via a learned scene-coordinate localization module, enabling efficient image-goal navigation without explicit 3D reconstruction.
